name: Dark Maker
source:
Remorseless age of near future. Far East branch. Students need to work and still accumulate debts. Assassination and sabotage become commonplace. This is a story that unfolds in such times with two different protagonists.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这是一个冷酷无情的近未来时代。故事发生在远东分部。学生们既要工作，又不断背负更多债务；暗杀与破坏行动已司空见惯。两名不同主人公的故事，就在这样的时代中展开。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
